        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"plantuml\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("@startuml\n@enduml\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
